licence: CC BY 4.0 (dataset card at the official page https://allenai.org/data/qasc, which links to the Hub card; the authors' repository https://github.com/allenai/qasc says "We release the data under CC BY license")
splits_used: train (8,134) and validation (926) = 9,060; the official test split has no answers or facts and is not used

deduplication.step1: drop repeated question ids (keep the first occurrence; train rows before validation rows, file order)
deduplication.step2: drop repeated normalized (stem + choices) text; key = norm(stem) + ' || ' + ' | '.join(sorted(norm(choice_text))) so that a re-ordered copy of the same question is also a duplicate; keep the first occurrence in the same order
deduplication.norm: unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse every whitespace run to one space, strip
